QUAD_EXTENSION_CONTEXT.statement: Knee-extension realization and hip position matter to regional quadriceps interpretation. No exact cable/bodyweight/sissy outcome is inferred from a seated-machine trial.

QUAD_PRESS_CONTEXT.statement: The verified press trial did not compare the two canonical foot-position variants. Glute/adductor/RF outcomes cannot be transferred a fortiori to a high-wide position.

HAMSTRING_HIP_EXTENSION_ONLY.statement: Hip-extension hamstring work does not establish knee-flexion or short-head completeness. No eighth slot added.

CALF_KNEE_POSITION.statement: Preserve knee-extended versus knee-flexed context: gastrocnemius responses can differ; seated soleus superiority is not established.

LATERAL_RAISE_COMPARATOR.statement: Cable/dumbbell comparison does not prove a profile-based hierarchy or directly validate behind-back low cable or seated bilateral variants.

PRESS_ANGLE_LIMIT.statement: Record press angle/context without assigning a regional hypertrophy percentage or inferring outcomes from acute EMG.

ROW_TRAJECTORY.statement: Upper-back intent preserved; lat/rear-delt attribution depends on loaded action and actual elbow trajectory, not a back-thickness score.
